Card case 7's dialog names corrected to the real catalog titles ('Verified work samples', 'Self-scheduling'). SparkLanding also listens to hashchange (an in-page link to #spotlight-<key> pins it), not only a mount-time read. Commit series is catalog -> feat(+tests) -> perf -> docs rather than test-then-feat: the lock was held by another session when the feature files were ready, so non-shared files were committed first per the lock rule. No new motion was added (stepping re-keys the preview body, which replays its existing motion-presets entrances), so the Spark motion-preset module needed no new call site.

Focus contract: the controls render AFTER the body so the close button stays useDialogA11y's first focus target; stepping swaps content inside the mounted dialog (no remount), so Escape restores focus to the card that opened it - the existing e2e focus test is unaffected by design. A hash-opened dialog has no trigger, so close restores focus to wherever it was (body). Arrows are handled in SparkLanding's existing window keydown (pinned only); useDialogA11y handles only Escape/Tab, no collision. Canonical/hreflang: every write is history.replaceState(null,'',pathname+search+hash); server metadata never sees the hash. E2E OWED: run e2e/landing.spec.ts (keyless subset) - the new case plus the existing spotlight focus case and the #features axe audit (the dialog gained two buttons and an aria-live line). loop_open: none for this card's rule - both pinned-opening surfaces (FeatureGrid onPin, VoiceTeaser) route through pinOpen, which writes the address; hover peeks are deliberately unaddressed.
